reference_model.unit_of_reference: study- and context-specific observation with uncertainty and evidence lineage
reference_model.forbidden_operation: collapse all admitted observations into one ideal human vector in v0.4
reference_model.future_objective: minimize expected context distance + matrix complexity + evidence-uncertainty penalty over admitted reference distributions
reference_model.future_objective_symbolic: M* = argmin_M [ E_{r~R} D(Phi(M),r) + lambda*C(M) + gamma*U(M) ]
reference_model.pareto_policy: Return Pareto-admissible candidates; no unique biological optimum may be asserted from model score alone.

admission_policy.minimum_rule_note: This is a fail-closed engineering admission threshold, not a claim that two studies establish a universal human standard.

claim_ceiling: This object defines evidence handling and admission rules, not a physiological reference standard.
Candidate source metadata are not automatically authoritative observations.
No human dose, formulation, treatment, food recommendation, infusion protocol or clinical target is encoded.
A future Pareto optimum would describe model fit to admitted evidence contexts only, not safety or efficacy in humans.
